factor_diagnostics.value_notes: NOAA reports adult canary rockfish mainly at 160-820 feet (about 49-250 m), sometimes to 1400 feet. A Washington/Oregon trawl analysis found 57-307 m, with over 90% of catch tows between 57 and 199 m. The configured 20-150 m range and 22-145 m ideal omit much of the observed adult depth distribution, so depth is only partly supported and the ideal is not validated.
